title: Pasting an image path with plain (unescaped) spaces, e.g. Finder 'Copy as Pathname', does not attach the image; the model's own read then fails on U+202F in the directory name
observed: kiln defect (parity). Fixture: a real PNG at …/shots/Screenshot 2026-10-04 at 3.41.07<U+202F>PM/Screenshot 2026-10-04 at 3.41.07<U+202F>PM.png. A bracketed paste of the path with plain spaces stayed as text (pasteAsImage in internal/tui/app.go rejects any paste with unescaped whitespace). On submit Opus called read with U+0020 in place of U+202F -> 'no such file or directory' (the read fallback internal/execenv/realpath.go amPmSpace '(?i) (AM|PM)\.' only fixes the file name, not the directory, which matches Claude Code's FileReadTool limit). It recovered via ls/find and copying the file to the scratchpad (2 extra tool calls, one outside-workspace prompt). The same path pasted with backslash-escaped spaces (terminal drag-and-drop form) became '[Image #1]' and worked, U+202F included.
expected: Claude Code's paste handler (src/utils/imagePaste.ts isImageFilePath/tryReadImageFromPath, src/hooks/usePasteHandler.ts) attaches a pasted image path read from the exact pasted bytes. kiln should also accept a single unescaped path (or a quoted one) that resolves to an existing image file.
